conclusion_svd: The nominal SVD selection was upstream. Under upstream fixed nominal association it matched the serving link. The local strongest-association extension changed that assumption without adapting SVD input, producing the audited fixed-strongest mismatch. This finding does not claim every upstream dynamic-association mode was audited.
conclusion_shadow: The dB-vs-lognormal-ln-sigma mismatch was already present in the upstream Release25-3 source.
